baseline.review_verdict: pending; integrity is not task-learning acceptance

sampling.moment: reset only; terminal batch feedback before any new assignment
sampling.initial_assignment: CP0 balanced phase=env_id modulo4 for every group, explicit assignments without sampler RNG draws, bound before environment construction; after CP0 every reset samples Uniform/SGS
terminal_order: close old assignments sorted by env_id/episode_id
reset controller states for done env_ids
assign new tasks sorted by env_id
sampling.time_limit: 20 s completion counts normally; hard budget partial episode is censored and never labelled failure
sampling.evaluation: fixed env_id modulo 4, no training sampler call or feedback
sampling.task_id: content SHA256 through B1 implementation; content hash and support version mandatory in logs

feedback.selection_status: common design proposal for review; no threshold tuning
feedback.label_semantics: joint_success_5cm = safe AND complete AND ee_position_rmse < .05 AND ee_orientation_mean < .2 AND xy_rmse < .15 AND yaw_rmse < .2
feedback.safe_semantics: complete AND no nonfoot force>1N event AND min base clearance>=.15m AND max velocity limit ratio<=1.0001 AND max joint limit excess<=.001rad
feedback.safety_termination: retain native base_contact .5N, bad_orientation 1rad, nonfoot_contact 5N after .5s; overlap preserved
feedback.tracking_limitation: historical success gates permit near-zero motion; report direction response gains and improvements against zero/fixed-center mathematical references separately

action.joint_binding: B3 action_joint_names/action_joint_ids and articulation_joint_names are distinct; verify runtime instead of slicing articulation order
action.mapping: leg raw12 and absolute arm q_ref6 => native action_manager a_exec18, using per-joint native scale/default offset and native clip
action.last_action_observation: native action_manager.action18, previous completed command; all arm entries kept
action.ppo_storage: raw sampled12 and 12d Gaussian logprob; no IK dimensions in policy likelihood
action.reset_semantics: native action/prev_action zeros on reset retained; IK state reset per env and lazily seeded from next actual noisy actor-input joint sample; do not read extra simulator truth or replace observed actions with q_ref

observations.policy_terms: inherit native full observation, including 18d last action and history; no arm padding/deletion
observations.ik_information_boundary: B3 must declare measured joints, command/frame transforms, nominal model and limits; no undeclared privileged simulator state

initialization.procedure: within each pair construct once with native seed21 architecture then clone exact actor/critic/distribution/normalizers; fresh Adam with zero state; save untrained pair checkpoint and hashes
initialization.cpu_native_initialization_verification: pending native torch/rsl_rl runtime; mock initialization is not proof

resolved_configuration.note: native runtime resolved obs_groups retained; actual YAML supplies model/algorithm class names omitted by snapshot plain()

budget.budget_unit: environment transitions, not episodes/SGS draws/wall time
budget.cutoff: finish exact 5000 updates; unfinished episodes censored; evaluation transitions excluded
budget.additional_seed_replication: common amendment required before launch; evaluation seeds are not training replicates

evaluation.primary: final checkpoint at matched transitions; macro average four task rates and report each task
evaluation.secondary: fixed planned checkpoints; T0 final-checkpoint side test for all groups, separately labelled
evaluation.direction_metrics: log actual desired group from assigned phase, avoid legacy env_id-only reconstruction in training metrics
evaluation.action_metrics: split by B3 action joint names; verify ordering before reusing legacy [:12]/[12:] diagnostics
evaluation.statistics: paired evaluation seeds/nuisance realizations; three eval seeds represent evaluation variability, not independent training-seed CI

checkpoint.restore_scope: CPU replay proves module state only; native physics replay needs saved simulator state or documented reset-boundary resume; no claim of bitwise full-run resume

pending_bindings: native 12d pair initialization artifact and empty optimizer proof
exact execution-host dependency versions and future B2 resolved runtime config (actual historical env/agent now in B1 reference/resolved)
common phase4/reset assignment and selected legacy feedback label review
native environment reset/terminal hooks and later physical validation
change_control: one B2 protocol version + hash for task/feedback/eval amendments; B1/B3 must acknowledge same hash; no window-private task modifications
